instructions_to_main_agent: The Magazine section of the homepage has been completely redesigned. The legacy '.mfd-home-magazine--rows' class has been removed and an asymmetrical grid editorial layout (2fr 1fr) has been implemented. The cards now feature large, impactful images with dark gradient overlays, and the titles (in Cormorant Garamond) are overlaid directly on the images to evoke a premium editorial feel, akin to Vogue Living or AD Italia.

Magazine.description: Editorial magazine section with 3 cards. The first card spans full height (hero), while the next two stack vertically on the right.

css_guidelines.description: Grid was updated to use a 2fr 1fr layout on desktop. Image zoom on hover implemented. Cards use a linear-gradient veil to ensure text contrast without muddying the whole image.
